v4io_scale.meaning: Vicon = 0.9583 × AutoPos → AutoPos v4-io is ~4.4% LARGER than Vicon truth (ranges are stretched by uncorrected common-mode delay)

common_mode_scale.meaning: Vicon = 1.0098 × AutoPos → After common-mode correction, AutoPos is ~1.0% SMALLER than Vicon truth

5d_scale_consistency.hardcoded_in_scripts: Only in run_final_data_audit.py (audit tracing script by design)
5d_scale_consistency.all_other_scripts: Compute scale fresh via Sim3/Procrustes alignment at runtime
5d_scale_consistency.physical_consistency: Common-mode delay correction (c=112mm) CONTRACTS AutoPos geometry: scale moves from 0.9583 (AutoPos too large) toward 1.0 and slightly past to 1.0098 (AutoPos slightly too small). Reciprocal: 1/0.9583-1 = +4.35%; 1/1.0098-1 = -0.97%.
